purpose: Source-verified, non-secret contracts for the 1.2 payment-health readers (FEATURE-PLAN.md item 1). Every name below was read from a tagged release; provenance and checksums are in the run receipt receipts/payment-source-verification.md. All values in synthetic_cases are invented test shapes, never store data.

cross_check.note: Newest checked tag installable on the toolkit's WooCommerce 10.9 floor. Webhook option names, int validation, mode logic and logger source are identical to 11.2.0.

method_ids.note: Card and Link orders are recorded under the main gateway ID 'stripe'; other UPE methods use 'stripe_' plus the method's STRIPE_ID.

delayed_authorisation.manual_effect: order set to on-hold with a transaction ID and no paid timestamp until the merchant captures; this is verified authorisation behaviour, not a broken checkout
delayed_authorisation.async_pending_charge_effect: a captured charge still pending at Stripe sets on-hold with a transaction ID; the webhook later completes it

settings.type: array (serialized); non-array is treated by Stripe as an empty array
settings.enabled: 'yes' means enabled; anything else is not enabled
settings.testmode: 'yes' means test mode; missing key inside an array means live (Stripe default 'no')

mode.unknown_when: settings option absent or not an array (toolkit rule; Stripe itself would fall back to live)

webhook_state.storage: separate scalar options, not keys of a structured option
webhook_state.timestamp_format: integer UTC Unix seconds stored as int or digit-only string
webhook_state.valid_value: scalar whose string form is ctype_digit; 0 means none recorded since monitoring began
webhook_state.invalid_value: non-scalar, empty string, sign, decimal point, exponent or any non-digit: Stripe reads it as 0, the toolkit treats it as malformed
webhook_state.missing_value: get_option default 0 in Stripe; the toolkit treats an absent option as missing, not as 0
webhook_state.success_written: after signature validation passes, the event's account matches and the event is dispatched (including deferred dispatch to Action Scheduler); value is the Stripe event's created time, not local processing time
webhook_state.failure_written: when signature validation fails; value is local time() at receipt
neither_written: request is not POST to wc-api=wc_stripe
event belongs to another Stripe account (acknowledged 200)
webhook_state.reset: when monitoring_began_at for the active mode reads as 0, Stripe sets it to now and resets success and failure to 0 and last_error to validation_succeeded
webhook_state.status_code_logic: Stripe's own status: success > failure is nominal; both 0 is none received; success > 0 otherwise is failure after success; else failure with no prior success. Equal non-zero values fall into failure after success in Stripe's message, which the toolkit does not adopt.
webhook_state.clock_caveat: success uses Stripe's event creation clock, failure uses the site clock; a successfully processed retry of an older event keeps an older success time

webhook_required_for_order_completion.reason: card payments that succeed are completed at checkout in process_response via payment_complete; the webhook is not the only completion path
webhook_required_for_order_completion.async_pending_charges: completed by webhook, but which stripe_* IDs are always async is not verified per method in this pass

logs.error_level_note: WC_Stripe_Logger::error does not check Stripe's own logging setting; WooCommerce's logging_enabled and level threshold still apply
logs.context_warning: the failure entry's context carries request headers and the event body; never output it

action_scheduler.note: Hooks verified in the webhook handler; not claimed to be the plugin's complete hook list.

stripe.replacement_note: Legacy method order 'stripe_sepa' maps to UPE 'sepa_debit' (gateway ID 'stripe_sepa_debit'). Legacy 'stripe' maps to UPE 'card', which keeps gateway ID 'stripe', so it is not a replacement.
stripe.registry_risk: Constructing Stripe UPE method objects reads payment method configuration; when its 20-minute cache is cold and the PMC API is enabled, Stripe fetches it from api.stripe.com and writes a cooldown option. Payment-health must not force gateway construction to read enabled state.

cod.default_status: processing, or on-hold when the order has a downloadable item
cod.paid_timestamp_note: processing status triggers maybe_set_date_paid, so COD orders get a paid timestamp before any money is collected

authority.note: Sync being on does not change which store is authoritative; read only the authoritative store.

hpos.indexes: wc_orders has type_status_date (type, status, date_created_gmt); wc_order_operational_data has no index on date_paid_gmt

legacy.paid_precedence: use _date_paid when its first row is truthy (non-empty and not '0'); otherwise _paid_date
legacy.date_paid_format: UTC Unix seconds as a numeric string; empty string when unset
legacy.paid_date_legacy_format: Y-m-d H:i:s in the site's local time (WC_DateTime::date); parse in the store timezone for that local time, not today's offset; empty string when unset
legacy.duplicate_meta: WordPress loads meta ORDER BY meta_id ASC and WooCommerce reads [0], so the lowest meta_id row of a key wins

gateway_registry.verified_by: lane core, 2026-11-15: includes/class-wc-payment-gateways.php at the 10.9.0 tag commit 0d7095c6066504a6fca229185ff363fd5785742d, SHA-256 1c9c8c9ab4b8ca6635dea7982c794bdbea4c5f9b023cc132bcd3063f6a72c725
gateway_registry.initialised_action: wc_payment_gateways_initialized (fired at the end of WC_Payment_Gateways::init(), since 8.5.0; line 137)
gateway_registry.instances_property: WC_Payment_Gateways::instance()->payment_gateways (public array of WC_Payment_Gateway objects keyed by sort position; line 30)
gateway_registry.construction_note: init() instantiates every class named by the woocommerce_payment_gateways filter (lines 92-104); the toolkit reads the registry only after the action has fired and never calls init() or a gateway method
gateway_registry.settings_option: woocommerce_<id>_settings (WC_Settings_API); the toolkit reads only the enabled key, plus testmode for Stripe

edit_url.hpos_side_effect: the helper calls wc_get_order() under HPOS and writes a debug log entry when the order is missing; build the shop_order URL directly to avoid hydration and log writes

hold_stock.cancellation_runs_when: held minutes >= 1 AND woocommerce_manage_stock === 'yes' AND the woocommerce_cancel_unpaid_orders_interval_minutes filter result >= 1
hold_stock.selects: pending orders of any registered order type whose last modified time is older than the hold window (not creation time)
hold_stock.scheduler: Action Scheduler hook woocommerce_cancel_unpaid_orders, group woocommerce (WP-Cron fallback)
hold_stock.parse: absent option uses the core default '60'; empty, 0 or non-numeric means not configured; positive integer with stock management on is configuration evidence, not proof a cancellation ran

logging.default_handler: LoggingUtil::get_default_handler() (constant WC_LOG_HANDLER, then option woocommerce_logs_default_handler, default Automattic\WooCommerce\Internal\Admin\Logging\LogHandlerFileV2)
logging.level_threshold: LoggingUtil::get_level_threshold() (constant WC_LOG_THRESHOLD, then option woocommerce_logs_level_threshold, default 'none' meaning all levels)
logging.retention_days: LoggingUtil::get_retention_period() (filter woocommerce_logger_days_to_retain_logs, else option woocommerce_logs_retention_period_days, default 30)
logging.log_directory: LoggingUtil::get_log_directory( false ) - pass false; the default true creates the directory
logging.file_name: <source>-YYYY-MM-DD-<hash>.log; source is everything before the last 4 dash segments; rotated files add .<n> to the source
logging.file_line: <ISO-8601 UTC 'c' time> <LEVEL upper case> <message>[ CONTEXT: <json>]; filterable by woocommerce_format_log_entry
logging.db_table: {prefix}woocommerce_log (log_id, timestamp datetime UTC, level smallint, source varchar(200), message longtext, context longtext NULL); index on level only

expect.note: failure is newer but 100 hours old; contract C8 makes it red only inside 72 hours; the 200-hour success is stale but webhook_required is false, so no stale allegation
proposed: equal values do not establish a newer failure (C8) and the two clocks differ, so ordering is unknown; lead to confirm
no verified expectation that these orders need the webhook, so no stale allegation
added by lane core, fix round 2 (pre-review miss 3, Q4): async stripe_* methods have no verified expectation either way, so a stale success with recent orders is unknown, neither amber nor green
wc_cancel_unpaid_orders reads get_option( 'woocommerce_hold_stock_minutes', '60' ), so an absent option behaves as 60
core compares 'yes' !== get_option( 'woocommerce_manage_stock' ) with no default
